problem_text:
A logistics company needs to allocate its delivery fleet among 17 regional distribution centers to maximize the total efficiency of the network.  
The characteristics of each center are as follows:  
* Center A: efficiency score 0.077, congestion factor 0.288, allocation range [0.064, 0.854]  
* Center B: efficiency score 0.090, congestion factor 0.184, allocation range [0.023, 0.659]  
* Center C: efficiency score 0.103, congestion factor 0.295, allocation range [0.059, 0.868]  
* Center D: efficiency score 0.032, congestion factor 0.212, allocation range [0.099, 0.744]  
* Center E: efficiency score 0.167, congestion factor 0.207, allocation range [0.023, 0.497]  
* Center F: efficiency score 0.137, congestion factor 0.292, allocation range [0.062, 0.467]  
* Center G: efficiency score 0.086, congestion factor 0.211, allocation range [0.090, 0.686]  
* Center H: efficiency score 0.032, congestion factor 0.106, allocation range [0.031, 0.756]  
* Center I: efficiency score 0.059, congestion factor 0.194, allocation range [0.074, 0.613]  
* Center J: efficiency score 0.074, congestion factor 0.266, allocation range [0.076, 0.887]  
* Center K: efficiency score 0.128, congestion factor 0.102, allocation range [0.062, 0.689]  
* Center L: efficiency score 0.197, congestion factor 0.257, allocation range [0.006, 0.473]  
* Center M: efficiency score 0.038, congestion factor 0.150, allocation range [0.037, 0.314]  
* Center N: efficiency score 0.117, congestion factor 0.107, allocation range [0.030, 0.808]  
* Center O: efficiency score 0.198, congestion factor 0.186, allocation range [0.015, 0.499]  
* Center P: efficiency score 0.173, congestion factor 0.180, allocation range [0.020, 0.445]  
* Center Q: efficiency score 0.051, congestion factor 0.121, allocation range [0.004, 0.624]  

Each center must receive a proportion of the total fleet that falls within its specified allocation range, and all proportions must sum to one.  
To maintain operational flexibility, the company requires that the group of high-mobility centers, represented by the subset M = {C, E, G, H, L, P, Q}, together receive at least 0.297 of the total fleet.  
Additionally, the overall network congestion index must not exceed 0.227, and the total efficiency score must be no less than 0.062.  
Determine the optimal fleet allocation proportions that maximize total efficiency while satisfying all constraints.
